name: AdvancedOCEmulator
purpose: Restore assets for the Advanced OpenComputers Emulator's 'Restore to OpenOS' button.

target.note: The EEPROM's code.lua is the bootloader. Overwriting it is what breaks the machine (e.g. flashing another OS installer over it).

openos_tree.note: Reference copy of the OpenOS tree. It is normally already installed on the machine's writable filesystem; the button only needs to restore the bootloader.
